entry.title: Free credit incentives for pay-per-use accounts
entry.content: Pay-per-use accounts can now earn free X API credits two ways: a one-time $20 when an account saves its first eligible payment card, and a one-time match of the first successful auto-recharge, up to $50 . A new account that earns both receives $70 in free credits. Credits are applied automatically with no code or form, appear in the Developer Console within about a minute, are spent before purchased credits, and expire 3 months after they are granted. The incentives are rolling out now.

entry.title: grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 end of life
entry.content: grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 is deprecated and reaches end of life on October 2, 2026. All requests to that slug are routed to grok-voice-transcribe-2.0 at the same price, with higher accuracy. See the Speech to Text docs.

entry.title: Real-time reply moderation guide now uses Grok
entry.content: We rewrote the Manage replies in real time integration guide. It now receives replies through the X Activity API post.reply.create event, classifies each reply with Grok through the xAI API using structured outputs, and hides high-confidence violations with the Hide Replies endpoint. The previous version relied on the deprecated Perspective API and the Account Activity API.

entry.title: Broadcast chat removal events for X Activity API
entry.content: Today, we added the broadcast.chat.remove event to the X Activity API . Subscribe by User ID with the broadcast.read scope to be notified in real time when the host or a moderator removes a chat message from a broadcast the user owns. The payload carries the broadcast_id and the message_id of the removed message.

entry.title: Migrate OAuth 1.0a user tokens to OAuth 2.0 with token exchange
entry.content: Apps with existing OAuth 1.0a users can now exchange each user’s stored OAuth 1.0a access token and secret for an OAuth 2.0 access token and refresh token, with no consent screen or re-authorization. Send grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange to POST /2/oauth2/token ; the granted scopes are derived from the permissions the user originally authorized, and offline.access is always included.

entry.title: safety\_identifier request field
entry.content: You can now send safety identifier , an opaque end-user identifier assigned by your application, on Chat Completions, the Responses API, deferred chat completions, the Batch API, and the gRPC GetCompletionsRequest . It lets SpaceXAI attribute a policy violation to one of your end users rather than to your API key. The legacy user field is still accepted. See the Security FAQ.

entry.title: Grok 4.7
entry.content: Grok 4.7, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API as grok-4.7 . Pricing is $2 / $0.50 / $6 per 1M tokens (input / cached input / output) below 200k prompt tokens, and $4 / $1 / $12 above. Reasoning effort supports low, medium, high (default), and xhigh. entry.title: grok-imagine-image-quality retirement on November 2
entry.content: On November 2, 2026, grok-imagine-image-quality is retired. Requests to the slug will be served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 with quality set to low , with no change to the request or response shape and at a lower per-image price. grok-imagine-image (1.0) is not affected. See the migration guide.

entry.title: Media upload and Post-create size and duration limits
entry.content: We documented the size and duration limits that apply when uploading media and when attaching it to a Post. Upload and POST /2/tweets are separately enforced. Limits follow the authenticated user’s X Premium / verified status and media_category , not your developer API plan.
